slides.0.title: The Wine of Origin system
slides.0.subtitle: Unit, Region, District, Ward
slides.1.title: The tiers and the body
slides.1.highlights.0.title: From broad to narrow
slides.1.highlights.0.content: Geographical Unit → Region → District → Ward; below sit the producer-level Estate Wine and Single Vineyard
slides.1.highlights.1.title: History of the scheme
slides.1.highlights.1.content: Foundation regulations took effect in 1972 and the scheme was instituted in 1973 under the 1957 Act; Geographical Units were added on 2 April 1993; the Liquor Products Act of 1989 replaced the 1957 Act
slides.1.highlights.2.title: The authority
slides.1.highlights.2.content: The Wine Certification Authority (WCA) oversees the scheme, renamed from the Wine and Spirit Board on 1 August 2023; SAWIS handles daily administration, inspections, traceability and seal issuance
slides.1.content: Unlike a European AOC, WO centres on the truth of origin and does not restrict varieties or methods.
slides.2.title: The five Regions of the Western Cape
slides.2.highlights.0.title: Coastal Region
slides.2.highlights.0.content: Contains eight Districts: Stellenbosch, Paarl, Swartland, Tulbagh, Wellington, Darling, Cape Town and Franschhoek Valley
slides.2.highlights.1.title: The other four Regions
slides.2.highlights.1.content: Cape South Coast, Breede River Valley, Klein Karoo and Olifants River (the northernmost)
slides.2.highlights.2.title: Counts vary by source and year
slides.2.highlights.2.content: There are about 32 Districts and about 102 Wards, but sources differ on scope (national or Western Cape only), so exact numbers are not examined; the number of Geographical Units also varies between sources
slides.2.content: Memorise the five Regions and Coastal's eight Districts; check the latest official list for other numbers.
slides.3.title: Labelling across tiers
slides.3.highlights.0.title: Blends move up a tier
slides.3.highlights.0.content: Blends across two Wards are labelled at District level, across Districts at Region level, across Regions at Geographical Unit level
slides.3.highlights.1.title: Estate and Single Vineyard
slides.3.highlights.1.content: Estate Wine must be made and bottled in the on-site cellar; a Single Vineyard is one registered block of no more than 6 ha
slides.3.content: Exam focus is the logic of moving up a tier, not the counts of each tier.
Which is the correct broad-to-narrow order of WO tiers?
Which is NOT a Region of the Western Cape?
Swartland is a District inside the Coastal Region.
At what tier must a blend across two Wards be labelled?
Which body has overseen the WO scheme since 1 August 2023?
The WCA was renamed from the Wine and Spirit Board.
